prompt: Create an original 90 second Japanese acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: koto, shakuhachi, soft hand drum. Style: sparse plucked phrases and gentle breathy flute, no voice. Tempo approximately 72 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A traditional Chinese instrumental piece featuring plucked strings, a melodic flute, and light percussion, creating a melancholic and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首传统中国器乐曲，以弹拨乐器、悠扬的笛子和轻柔的打击乐器为主，营造出忧郁而沉思的氛围。
